title: Creation Is Unfinished
summary: The epilogue turns the reader into a participant: the network remains distributed, the book distinguishes science from speculation, and Read / Explore / Create opens the canon to World Seeds, translations, contributions, and forks.

links.note: The unfinished ending returns the reader to the first vibration as a new possibility.
Readers become contributors through the Open Architects model.
The Second Creation becomes the immediate memory of the open universe.
